headline: Nava allots 23,550 equity shares under RSU Plan 2023 at ₹498 each
hook: Small equity dilution for Nava shareholders
summary: Nava has allotted 23,550 equity shares under its Restricted Stock Unit Plan 2023 at an issue price of ₹498 per share. This routine corporate action increases the company's total paid-up equity base slightly. Such ESOP and RSU allocations have a negligible financial impact on retail shareholders. Indian retail investors tracking Nava can view this as standard employee compensation processing.
why_it_matters: Minimal equity dilution from routine employee stock option allotment.
